t: Where Can I Buy an Intel Processor?
s: Intel® Boxed Desktop Processors are sold to end users who want to build their own desktop PCs. Trayed processors are sold to high-volume manufacturers or OEMs (stands for original equipment manufacturers). PC OEMs are typically large companies like Acer, ASUS, Dell, Hewlett-Packard, and Lenovo. They buy processors in bulk, incorporate them into PCs (laptops, desktops, All-in-Ones), and provide complete warranty and technical support services for the systems directly themselves.
